title: You May Not Finish What You Started
text: Our creator is a generational creator. I did a little study on his attitude years ago, and I discovered that he never speaks to you. I know that sound weird, but whenever he speaks, he ain't talking to you. He's talking to your loins. He always talks to your loins. See, he When he speaks, he's talking to what you're carrying, not you. He would say things like your seed shall be blessed. He ain't talking to you. Through you, the nation shall be blessed. He ain't talking to you. He's talking to what you're carrying. He's always thinking beyond you. You You're just temporary. Listen. Stop thinking you're permanent. This is not about you. It's about the eggs you're carrying. It's about the sperms you're carrying. That's what this is about. He thinks generationally. This is why one day to him is like a thousand years. Let me tell you what we think that may be disturbing us deeply. We think that we were born to finish what we started. Mentoring and succession is the acceptance of the reality that you may not finish what you started.
